verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developers.dialpad.com (HTTP 200) that indexes guides and API reference entries such as recordings, OAuth, websockets and call control. A second llms.txt exists on www.dialpad.com, and docs pages are served as markdown (.md) with agentTools/projectIndex frontmatter pointing agents to the index. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths (all 404), no evidence of an llms-full.txt or independent user corroboration of agent use.
